name: Hasunuma Haruno
source:
Protagonist's younger sister who appears in each story in the background. Haruno is grown up for her age. She loves all kinds of reptiles, such as snakes. Her dream for the future is to be a spy.

[Translated from the game's [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20051215084453/http://www.russel.co.jp/hp/adult/trois/trois_chara.html]official website[/url]]
